content: {"episode_id": "ep-05019", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "CO-197", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
